pack:
## Who they are
The Navy SEAL Foundation (NSF) provides critical support for the warriors, veterans and families of Naval Special Warfare (NSW). Their goals for video: awareness and donations, an established following on TikTok, and adoption of the "I Am That Warrior" campaign (premiered 5 Feb 2026 at the Houston gala). "I Am That Warrior" widens "warrior" to operators, enablers, families, NSF and donors.

## People
- Chris Irwin: VP of Communications, the Navy SEAL Foundation. Approves cuts. Prefers email to Slack.
- Geoff Leard: Director, Partnerships & Athletic Events (not "Jeff").
- Kat (Kathryn) Green: Event Coordinator. Ran the Sanctuary Golf Classic.
- Ashley Morrison (Ironclad, NSF's review vendor): reviews and approves cuts on NSF's side.
- Our lead: Atdhe.

## What every cut should do
- Social-first, short-form, human-forward. Show why the Navy SEAL Foundation matters to real people.
- From events: hero motion shots, who-are-you-here-for answers, Opening and Closing ceremony anchors, light on-course fun. TikTok-native framing (comment-reply overlays, kinetic captions) is on brand.
- Tone depends on the moment: loose and fun for donor, sponsor and volunteer answers; solemn and respectful for the Toast to the Fallen and any mention of fallen teammates or their families. A cut may lead with the solemn beat and end on a light golf answer. Never campy.
- Put the question on screen when someone answers it (Frame.io notes on NSF cuts, May and Sept 2026).

## Hard rules
- Always "the Navy SEAL Foundation". Never "Navy SEAL Foundation" without "the" in captions, supers or voice-over. Chris: "Getting sick of saying it over and over."
- SEAL is always in capitals and singular in captions, even when the speaker says "SEALs".
- "the Foundation" has a capital F; "this foundation", "our foundation", "a foundation" are lower case.
- No one in uniform on screen. Cut around uniform frames.
- Active-duty NSW members are never identified on camera without consent (OPSEC).
- Real voices only. Never an AI voice. Use Nick's real voice-over where a VO is needed.
- Dial back AI audio cleanup: a little noise is fine, over-cleaning hurts the voice.
- No campy sound effects. Proofread every word before delivery. Never end abruptly.
- Match the brand-colour reference Chris texted to Atdhe and Nick before locking a cut.

## Spellings
- Navy SEAL Foundation, the Navy SEAL Foundation, NSF, SEAL, the Foundation, this foundation.
- Naval Special Warfare (NSW). I Am That Warrior. Red Wings (not "Red Veins").
- Danny Dietz: Navy SEAL killed 28 June 2005 in Operation Red Wings; family nickname "DJ"; never "David".
- Tiffany Bitz: Danny Dietz's sister (not "Bitts" or "Betts").
- Chris Irwin, Geoff Leard.

## Sanctuary Golf Classic (Thu 25 June 2026, Sanctuary Golf Course, Sedalia, Colorado)
- About 140 guests: Foundation donors, sponsors, the host committee, active-duty and retired NSW community.
- Run of show: 9:00 registration and brunch, 11:00 Opening Ceremony with the National Anthem, 11:30 shotgun start and on-course activities, 4:30 cocktail reception, 5:00 evening program (keynote by active-duty NSW couple Peter and Candace McVey; Toast to the Fallen by Capt. (Ret.) Christopher Brown, USN), 6:00 close.
- Interview questions: describe the Navy SEAL Foundation in one word, and why; why do you keep coming back; best golf tip. On-course activation: Push-ups for Putts.
- Shot by Steph Lau, vertical. Chris on the first two Sanctuary clips (Anthony Gonzalez, Capt. Chris Brown): "So far these clips from Sanctuary are great!"

- Chris, 21 May: "When you say 'the' Foundation, Foundation is capitalized. When you say 'this' foundation, it isn't." / "Even though he says 'SEALs', write 'SEAL'."
- 19 May: "SEAL should be in all caps." / "do we have him saying a call to action? or can we add an end card? feels like it ends abruptly"
